description: Modify the app's AsyncStorage: set a key, remove a key, or clear supported app AsyncStorage keys (Buoy's own devtool keys are preserved). Values are stored as strings — JSON-encode objects yourself.

action.description: set/remove a key, or clear supported app AsyncStorage keys.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

key.description: The key (required for set and remove).

value.description: The string value to store (required for set; JSON-encode objects).

name: storage_action
